html: פקע (√ of foll., meaning dub.; NH פָּקַע split, spring off; cf. 𝔗 Ithpe., Syriac ܦܩܰܥ burst, crash; NH פְּקַעַת is ball, roll, פְּקִיעַ wick, הִפְקִיעַ denom.; Arabic فَقَعَ is be yellow, also break wind, ii. crack finger-joints, etc.; Ecclus 46:17 פקע crash; 𝔗 פְּקַע roll noisily; Syriac ܦܰܩܥܳܐ crash, crack).
